Dense-520 low also misses the 100 ms pointer-feedback budget; dense-520 normal meets the 75 ms pointer-feedback budget. Fresh and populated meet both budgets at both settings.
interpretation.cpuAndRendererLimit: The measured synchronous JavaScript render-call p95 is below 40 ms low and 20 ms normal in every scenario, including dense-520. In local and world-1023, the much longer frame intervals occur alongside render-call p95 below 2 ms. This establishes that the interval delays are outside the measured JavaScript render-call duration; this headless SwiftShader run does not attribute them to a specific browser, scheduling, graphics-driver, or GPU cause.
